name: Astra Psychiatry | AdvancedMD Design Studio v5 — Organized implementation master

pages.title: 01 · Patient & requester
pages.desc: Appointment request only. Adults age 18+ must submit their own requests. Parent/guardian requests are accepted only for patients under 18.

fields.label: Important: appointment requests for adults
fields.help: Patients age 18 or older must submit their own appointment requests. Parents, partners and other third parties cannot initiate the request on an adult’s behalf. For ages 13–17, a parent or legal guardian may request care; assess minor-consent/privacy requirements before portal access.

fields.label: Who is submitting this appointment request?
options: I am the parent or legal guardian of a patient under 18
fields.help: Adults 18+ must submit for themselves; a parent or legal guardian may request for a minor, subject to applicable consent rules.

rules.when: IF requester selects parent/guardian AND patient age calculated from DOB is 18 or older
rules.detail: Display: Adults must submit their own request. Do not continue or create a proxy request.

rules.when: IF patient age calculated from DOB is under 18 AND requester is parent/guardian
rules.detail: Display parent/guardian name, relationship and contact fields.

fields.label: Patient date of birth
fields.help: Age is calculated from this birth date to determine whether guardian questions and staff review are needed.

rules.when: IF patient age at request is under 13
rules.detail: Outside current Astra age range: do not book automatically; advise team review.

rules.when: IF patient age is 18 or older AND requester is not the patient
rules.detail: Adult patient must initiate request personally.

fields.label: Gender / sex marker for insurance registration (required)
fields.help: Choose the marker required for your insurance/registration record. Gender identity is a separate optional question during intake. If the choices do not match your coverage, select assistance.

rules.when: IF insurance plan requires a specific sex/gender marker for member match
rules.detail: Verify payer value securely; never infer gender identity from an insurance marker or silently change the patient record.

fields.label: State where the patient will be physically located for telehealth
fields.help: Please select your planned physical location during appointments, not simply your mailing address.

rules.when: IF patient’s location is outside DE, CT, NY
rules.detail: Do not automatically approve a telehealth appointment.

fields.label: Parent/legal guardian information
options: Legal authority or custody note (if needed)

rules.when: IF requester is parent/legal guardian AND patient is under 18
rules.detail: Request guardian details; staff confirm authority and state-specific consent/privacy rules.

fields.label: Guardian attestation for a minor
options: I confirm I am authorized to request care for this minor
fields.help: I confirm that I am the minor patient’s parent/legal guardian or other authorized decision-maker. Staff will verify authority where needed.

fields.label: Requester acknowledgment
options: I understand that adult patients (18+) must request their own appointments

fields.label: Minor requesting their own appointment — consent review
fields.help: If the patient is younger than 18 and is submitting for themself, staff must determine applicable NY/CT/DE adolescent-consent and guardian-contact requirements before proceeding.

pages.title: 02 · Appointment preferences
pages.desc: Select preferred format and contact window. This remains a request until Astra approves it.

fields.label: Preferred time windows
options: Telehealth outside in-person hours if available

fields.label: How soon would you like an appointment?
How did you hear about Astra?
Location and hours
fields.help: In-person appointments are by appointment only at 39682 Sunrise Ct, Office 202, Bethany Beach, DE. In-person hours: Mon–Thu, 9 AM–5 PM. Telehealth scheduling may vary. Office closed Fridays.

fields.label: Telehealth / in-person location guidance
fields.help: Telehealth is offered for patients physically in NY, CT and DE, subject to practice/state requirements. In-person appointments are in Bethany Beach, DE by appointment. Final availability depends on provider scheduling.

pages.title: 03 · Reason for visit
pages.desc: A brief clinical overview for routing—not a complete psychiatric evaluation.

fields.label: What would you like help with?
Which service best describes your request?
options: Transfer medication management from another prescriber
Medication management with psychotherapy when clinically appropriate

rules.detail: Astra does not accept therapy-only appointments; staff provide appropriate next steps.

fields.label: Do you currently see a psychiatric medication prescriber?
In a few sentences, what brings you to Astra? (optional)
Are you looking to transfer care and willing to have prior treatment information reviewed?
Records release timing
fields.help: Do not request or execute a release of information (ROI) on this prescreen. If records are available, offer a recipient-specific ROI during the approved intake packet.

pages.title: 04 · Focused clinical review
pages.desc: Use the substance and recent-care questions in Astra’s existing prescreener. Flag concerning answers for human review; do not auto-diagnose or automatically reject.

fields.label: Are you currently receiving a long-acting injectable psychiatric medication (e.g., Invega Sustenna, Abilify Maintena, Aristada or Haldol decanoate)?

rules.detail: Flag because Astra does not currently administer/manage LAIs; obtain clinician decision.

fields.label: Are you currently receiving medication treatment for opioid use disorder (e.g., buprenorphine/Suboxone, methadone, Vivitrol)?

rules.detail: Astra does not currently provide MAT/OUD treatment; clinician/admin review.

fields.label: Are you currently experiencing active eating-disorder symptoms, such as bingeing, purging or significant food restriction?

rules.detail: Clinical review of acuity, medical stability and appropriate setting; do not automatically exclude.

fields.label: Within the past 30 days, have any of the following occurred?
options: Emergency department visit for mental health concerns
Suicide attempt or self-harm requiring medical attention

rules.when: IF any item other than None is selected
rules.detail: Manual clinical review required before approval; None is mutually exclusive.

fields.label: Are you currently experiencing any of these perceptual experiences?
options: Hearing things other people do not hear
Seeing things other people do not see
Feeling that others are trying to harm you or are out to get you

rules.when: IF any positive response or Prefer to discuss
rules.detail: Prompt clinician review; never diagnose psychosis from the answer alone. None is mutually exclusive.

fields.label: Have you previously received a diagnosis of schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder?

rules.detail: Astra exclusion/fit requires clinical review; do not automatically deny.

fields.label: Are you currently enrolled in any of the following?

rules.when: IF active higher level of care selected
rules.detail: Coordinate appropriate clinical review before scheduling; None is exclusive.

fields.label: Additional information about any response above (optional)

rules.when: IF any relevant prescreen response is positive, unsure, or prefer to discuss
rules.detail: Provide a nonjudgmental optional explanation box.

fields.label: Not for emergencies
fields.help: This request form is not monitored for emergencies. For immediate danger call 911; for suicidal crisis in the U.S., call or text 988. Request submissions are reviewed during business operations.

pages.title: 05 · Insurance & payment
pages.desc: Collect insurance identifiers and secure card images when applicable; offer patient-initiated eligibility inquiry (requires AMD/payer integration). Self-pay bypasses insurance fields.

fields.label: How do you intend to pay for appointments?
fields.help: Insurance patients can provide card images and request an eligibility review. Self-pay patients see published self-pay fees. Medicare/Medicaid requires staff confirmation of active participation.

rules.detail: Coverage depends on payer, state and enrollment status; do not imply participation.
Show basic insurance fields and request eligibility review.
Display published rates and acknowledgement; collect card only later via secure payment processor.

fields.label: Insurance carrier
fields.help: Select the plan you would like Astra to verify. Eligibility and network participation are subject to staff confirmation.

rules.detail: Show to insurance patients only; carriers listed are examples, NOT network participation promises.
Insurance details are preliminary.

fields.label: Insurance member ID / policy number
fields.help: Required when requesting benefits verification; enter as shown on card. Do not use a Social Security number.

rules.detail: Do not make mandatory before request review.

fields.label: Insurance card — FRONT
fields.help: Secure image/PDF capture. In the demonstration, the file name is displayed but no document is stored or transmitted.

fields.label: Insurance card — BACK
fields.help: Collect reverse side with payer contact and claims information. Store securely in the EHR.

fields.label: Check my insurance benefits
fields.help: Patient-initiated demonstration of benefits inquiry; a real eligibility/benefit result requires a connected AMD/clearinghouse transaction and should include date, network context, limitations and disclaimer.
fields.destination: Dated eligibility/benefits verification record; front-end patient status

rules.when: IF payer/member identifiers and subscriber details are available AND patient selects Check my benefits
rules.detail: Invoke approved AdvancedMD clearinghouse/payer 270/271 capability if available, return date/time and source; show partial/unknown status rather than inventing coverage. Display office in/out-of-network caveats and explain eligibility is not guarantee of payment.

fields.label: Self-pay fee preview
fields.help: Initial psychiatric evaluation: $325 • Follow-up: $150. Full financial policies, applicable Good Faith Estimate and secure card-on-file authorization are delivered after approval.

rules.detail: Do not collect full card numbers or CVV in this form.

fields.label: Self-pay fee acknowledgment
options: I have reviewed the displayed self-pay fees

rules.detail: Confirm understanding; no automatic charge.

fields.label: Coverage verification status
fields.help: If payer data is unavailable, show “Pending verification” and provide a way to request assistance. Never display an invented copay or claim guaranteed coverage.

pages.title: 06 · Submit & staff approval
pages.desc: Request form submission does not equal approval or booked appointment. Staff-only work queue checks identity, age, clinical flags and insurance; only approved appointments trigger targeted intake.

fields.label: Privacy & contact notice
fields.help: An appointment request is not a confirmed appointment. Use our office phone or text for routine questions. Do not send urgent or emergency concerns through this form.

fields.label: Patient/requester acknowledgment
options: I understand this is a request and my appointment is not confirmed until Astra approves it

fields.label: Confirmation message
fields.help: Thank you for requesting an appointment with Astra Psychiatry. Our team will review your information and contact you regarding next steps. Do not consider an appointment confirmed until you receive an approval/confirmation.

fields.label: What happens after you submit?
fields.help: Our team reviews the request and any clinical/insurance questions. If approved, you receive confirmation and an individualized intake packet. No intake documents are sent solely because you requested an appointment.

fields.label: Internal staff review — not visible to patient
Administrative review checklist (staff-facing, not patient-facing)
options: Patient age / adult self-request rule satisfied
Clinical prescreen reviewed and concerns routed

fields.label: Only after approval → send intake packet
fields.help: On APPROVED status: confirm the chosen appointment, create/update the patient record without duplicate demographics, send age/visit/payment-appropriate intake documents and track completion. Never send full intake or ROI automatically merely because a request was submitted.

rules.when: IF internal request status becomes Approved
rules.detail: Assign adult/minor + telehealth/in-person + insurance/self-pay packet; staff verify legal/financial requirements.

pages.title: 01 · Demographics, guardian & ID
pages.desc: Prepopulate approved-request fields; patient verifies and completes missing items.

fields.label: Intake is sent ONLY after appointment approval
fields.help: Carry forward legal name, DOB, contact, state, visit format, appointment and preliminary payment status. Ask the patient to confirm rather than re-enter the same information.

fields.label: Legal name (prepopulated; verify)
fields.help: Please check the name we received with the appointment request and correct it if needed.

fields.label: Date of birth (prepopulated; verify)
fields.help: This date is carried over from the appointment request. Please verify it.

fields.label: Gender / sex marker on insurance registration (required)
fields.help: Verify the insurance/registration marker shown on your application. Gender identity and pronouns are optional, separate fields.
fields.extra: Do not overwrite optional gender identity and pronouns to satisfy payer enrollment; flag discrepancy for staff matching.

fields.label: Gender identity (optional)
fields.help: Optional; not used as a substitute for the payer demographic marker.
fields.destination: Patient-reported gender identity — separate optional demographic field

fields.label: Pronouns (optional)
fields.destination: Patient preference; distinct from insurance marker

fields.label: Parent / legal guardian / custody information (minor only)

rules.detail: Apply NY/CT/DE minor privacy and consent requirements; do not automatically give guardians blanket access.
Prevent guardian/proxy from using the minor workflow. Staff review supported legal representative exceptions separately.

fields.label: Accepted identity documents and data security
fields.help: Provide photo ID only through a protected portal, with staff verification and retention limits. Identity verification does not automatically authorize portal/proxy access.

fields.label: Patient photo ID — adult patient
fields.help: Secure government-issued photo ID for identity verification when patient is 18+. The demo only displays file name; do not use real identifying documents in this prototype.

fields.label: Parent/legal guardian photo ID — minor patient
fields.help: Provide guardian/authorized-adult ID only when appropriate for the applicable minor consent and custody rules; staff verifies authority and portal access.

fields.label: Minor patient photo ID (if available)
fields.help: Optional: many adolescent patients do not have a government-issued photo ID.

fields.label: Identity-document privacy & verification
fields.help: Images must be stored via authenticated HIPAA-appropriate patient upload, with access restrictions and retention policies. The demo uses file names only. Do not collect or transmit actual documents through this static local design example.

pages.title: 02 · Presenting concerns
pages.desc: Long-form patient account to inform the clinician, not a diagnosis assignment.

fields.label: In your words, what prompted you to seek treatment?
Over the past few months, these symptoms have generally:
What would you most like to accomplish in treatment?
Anything else your clinician should know before meeting? (optional)

pages.title: 03 · Psychiatric history
pages.desc: Preserve what patients report; do not equate this with a clinician-confirmed problem list.

fields.label: Which diagnoses have you been told you have?
Have you ever had inpatient psychiatric treatment or a higher level of care?
Psychiatric hospital, PHP, IOP, residential, detox or rehab episode

rules.when: IF prior hospitalization / higher level of care is Yes
rules.detail: Allow multiple separate episodes with dates, facilities, outcomes.

fields.label: TMS, ECT, esketamine / Spravato, ketamine or other intervention course
Relevant past self-harm, suicide attempts, psychiatric emergency visits or safety concerns (if comfortable sharing)
Safety documentation boundary
fields.help: Patient reports do not replace direct, current clinician risk assessment. Positive/uncertain safety responses go to clinical review rather than auto-generated negative findings.

pages.title: 06 · Surgeries & allergies
pages.desc: Separate repeated episodes and reactions.

fields.label: Have you had surgery or a significant procedure?

rules.detail: Allow unlimited repeat entries.

fields.label: Do you have any medication, food or other allergies?

rules.detail: Provider verifies and reconciles into native AdvancedMD allergy list.

pages.desc: Checkbox grid modeled after AdvancedMD examples: each marked relative × condition can have its own details.

fields.label: Family psychiatric history (check all that apply)
options: Suicide attempt or death by suicide
fields.columns: Mother, Father, Sibling, Child, Maternal grandparent, Paternal grandparent, Other relative

fields.label: Family history knowledge
options: Known family history is recorded above

fields.label: Additional information about an individual checked matrix cell

fields.help: Request checkbox matrix plus optional condition-specific comments per selected relationship. A single “sibling” column should allow details distinguishing multiple siblings. The editor supports changing rows and columns.

pages.title: 09 · Medications & past trials
pages.desc: Patient-reported medication history routes to clinician reconciliation; do not create prescriptions automatically.

fields.label: Current prescription medications, OTCs and supplements
Medication source of truth
fields.help: After clinician review, AdvancedMD’s native medication reconciliation/eRx list remains authoritative. Maintain previous psychiatric trials as longitudinal history only.

pages.title: 10 · Social & developmental history
pages.desc: Use conditional, optional details where sensitive; age-appropriate wording for patients 13+.

fields.label: Who are your main supports, and what helps you cope?
Developmental history, childhood, school concerns or prior evaluations (optional)
Important trauma or adverse life experiences (optional; may discuss in appointment instead)
Sensitive disclosures
fields.help: Patients may prefer not to describe traumatic events in a portal form. Provider handles additional details during clinical interview; confidentiality limitations vary for minors and protected information.

pages.title: 11 · Substance use history
pages.desc: Categorized exposure with repeatable details, including caffeine and prescribed-use clarification.

fields.label: Have you currently or previously used any of these?

rules.detail: Offer one entry per substance; do not mix all substances into a single generic text field.

fields.label: Prior substance use treatment or relevant concerns (optional)

pages.title: 12 · Care team & releases
pages.desc: Capture one provider at a time; if communication is authorized, generate a separate recipient-specific ROI.

fields.label: Other clinicians involved in your care
options: Provider type (PCP, therapist, prescriber, specialist, other)
Would you like Astra to communicate with this provider? (Yes / No / Discuss first)
fields.help: Repeat one entry per outside clinician. Each entry must carry its own yes/no/discuss ROI choice; written authorizations are recipient-specific and separately signed.

fields.label: One authorization decision and ROI per outside clinician
options: Yes, send an authorization for my review
fields.help: For EACH repeated outside provider, ask whether communication is requested. If yes, present an individual recipient-specific ROI for authorized scope/signature. A single global yes/no cannot authorize multiple distinct recipients. Follow adolescent confidentiality, HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 rules when applicable.
fields.destination: Recipient-specific ROI queue / restricted document storage

rules.when: IF any care-team entry requests communication
rules.detail: Create a distinct, accurately prefilled release for that individual provider; check scope, signing authority, date and revocation.

fields.label: ROI destination and limits
fields.help: Each valid signed ROI is stored in the consent/ROI repository with patient, recipient, purpose, permitted information, expiration and revocation status. For minors and 42 CFR Part 2 information apply appropriate restrictions.

pages.title: 13 · Screening measures
pages.desc: Selected questionnaires depend on clinician, age and clinical indication.

fields.label: Questionnaire handling
fields.help: Present actual validated instrument wording separately; store date, version, total score and component responses. Scores do not automatically establish diagnoses. Make latest results available for selective encounter note insertion.

fields.label: Screeners may be assigned dynamically
fields.help: Clinical team may modify the packet after approval. Avoid assigning the entire battery without indication; age-appropriate selection and privacy protections apply.

pages.title: 14 · Consents & completion
pages.desc: Packet is selected using existing DOB, modality and payment fields. Collect separate consents, track signatures/ID/eligibility, and secure access before provider encounter.

fields.label: Assign documents based on request details
Conditional intake packet builder
fields.help: ADULT or MINOR × TELEHEALTH or IN-PERSON × COMMERCIAL INSURANCE or SELF-PAY. Attach treatment consent, privacy acknowledgment, relevant telehealth consent, financial policy and applicable minor documents. Never release signed forms to an unauthorized proxy.

rules.detail: Deliver appropriate versioned intake + policy packet.

fields.label: Required consent documents — intake packet index (not patient-selectable opt-out)
options: Comprehensive consent to outpatient psychiatric care
Parent/guardian rights and consent addendum (if minor)
fields.help: Each applicable document is provided for review and separate acknowledgment/signature; checklist here demonstrates packet contents, not permission to skip required forms.

fields.label: For self-pay patients
fields.help: Present published fees, applicable Good Faith Estimate, financial policy and a PCI-compliant hosted/tokenized card-on-file authorization. Never collect PAN/CVV in normal form fields or PDFs. Do not charge without appropriate consent.

rules.detail: Secure, hosted card-on-file entry; staff confirm financial workflow.

fields.label: For insurance patients
fields.help: Collect missing subscriber details / insurance card as needed. Verify eligibility and relevant mental-health/telehealth benefits if available, with date/time/source and carve-out exceptions. Eligibility is not payment guarantee.

rules.detail: Insurance card capture and staff benefits verification.

fields.label: Insurance card front received (from appointment request)
fields.help: Example receipt of previously supplied insurance image; native EHR should retain the original secure document, not require a duplicate upload.

fields.label: Insurance card back received (from appointment request)
Replacement insurance card / updated images (if changed)
Telehealth consent — conditional packet
fields.help: Assign when the APPROVED appointment is telehealth, including when the original request said “either”. The prototype approximates packet routing using patient preference; AMD should use final confirmed appointment modality.

fields.label: Minor packet — consent, custody and confidentiality
fields.help: Display Astra parent/guardian consent addendum plus separate adolescent information receipt; route correct signature authority and configure confidential communications and proxy-access review.

fields.label: Self-pay / Good Faith Estimate packet
fields.help: Include current fee acknowledgment, financial policy, applicable Good Faith Estimate and a separate secure/tokenized payment authorization. Do not ask for full card number/CVV in a normal form.

fields.label: Insured patient packet / coverage check
fields.help: Review current plan, stored front/back insurance card images, eligibility status and billing authorization. Benefits may differ by provider, service, visit modality and date.

fields.label: Applicable patient / guardian attestation (signature simulation)
fields.help: A real implementation uses compliant e-signature with identity, date, document version, signer authority and audit trail; this demo text entry is not a legally binding signature.

fields.label: When all intake requirements are completed
fields.help: Submit → patient chart receives discrete, source-labeled histories where supported; forms are retained; medication/allergy require review; clinical history is patient-reported until verified; staff see completion status.

fields.label: Patient portal / secure messaging activation
fields.help: After approval send portal setup instructions and assign age-appropriate access. For minors, keep confidential and proxy-access settings subject to clinician/legal review.

fields.label: Intake packet completion tracker
fields.help: Staff view: required documents/signatures received, ID verified, insurance verified or pending, completed assigned screeners, ROI statuses and outstanding items. Provider sees unresolved issues before visit.

pages.title: 01 · Encounter narrative
pages.desc: ONE large editable current-visit narrative. Longitudinal HPI stays inside this text; no duplicated required HPI or sections.

fields.label: Visit context (read-only header)
fields.help: Encounter date/time • patient • DOB • state/location • telehealth/in-person • clinician • appointment type. Native encounter metadata should be available without repeated manual entry.

fields.label: Encounter narrative / GPT-assisted draft (clinician reviews)
fields.help: Single large editable narrative including HPI within the narrative. Do not require a separate duplicate HPI field; clinician must review all generated text before signing.
fields.placeholder: Paste the complete narrative: reason for visit, interval update, longitudinal HPI, ROS where relevant, formulation, assessment, plan, psychotherapy intervention/time when applicable, follow-up…

fields.label: Note assembly guidance
fields.help: No extra required HPI box. Do not automatically duplicate the same history, assessment or plan below the narrative. Preview assembled output before signing; no GPT text enters chart without clinician review.

pages.title: 02 · Mental status examination
pages.desc: Apply Standard Normal is an editable starting template, not an attestation. Provider confirms the findings from THIS encounter.

fields.label: MSE controls
fields.help: [ Apply Standard MSE ]   [ Start Blank ]   [ Clear ]   [ Clinician confirms current findings ]

fields.label: Safety review is NOT a preset normal checkbox
fields.help: Suicidal ideation, homicidal ideation and hallucination denials must not auto-populate from Apply Standard MSE. Current safety findings require actual assessment, documentation and clinician confirmation.

pages.title: 03 · Clinical data selection
pages.desc: Default is NOT to insert old scores, tests or vitals. Show latest dated values and provider selects only reviewed/relevant items.

Select reviewed information to include in the current note
options: PMP review (ONLY if performed and documented)

fields.label: Date and source formatting
fields.help: Example: PHQ-9 completed 10/09/2026 — total score 12 (illustrative). DO NOT display it as a current-day score unless assessed then. Patient-reported vitals stay labeled as patient-reported.

fields.label: Structured tabs requested
fields.help: Screeners | Vitals | Labs | Pharmacogenetics | PMP | Other. Most recent value is shown with expandable trend/history; checkboxes control note inclusion.

fields.label: Medical history

fields.label: Hospitalizations, programs and interventional psychiatric treatments
Carry-forward safeguard
fields.help: Patient-entered histories are available for clinician verification and later edits. Keep dates/provenance, avoid blanket insertion into every current note, and never alter historical signed encounters.

fields.label: Selected-diagnosis clinical status
fields.help: Status must be applied to the selected diagnosis, not globally to all diagnoses. Rule-out/differential diagnoses should not silently become billable confirmed diagnoses.

fields.label: Diagnosis selection and documentation rules
fields.help: Each confirmed diagnosis should have its own code and status. Do not place rule-outs in claims. Current ICD-10-CM must be validated natively; severity, remission and episode choices must map to exactly one billable code where supported.

pages.title: 06 · Medications & eRx
pages.desc: Use AdvancedMD native medication reconciliation and eRx. Past trials are separate longitudinal history.

fields.label: Native medication list controls
fields.help: [ Reconcile ] [ Start new Rx ] [ Renew ] [ Modify ] [ Discontinue ] [ Check allergies/interactions ] [ PMP as appropriate ]. Do not maintain a duplicate manually typed active med list.

fields.label: Medication reconciliation / controlled-substance safeguards
fields.help: Verify each active medicine against the native AdvancedMD medication list, review allergies and interactions, confirm PMP when clinically required, and apply Astra controlled-medication policy and refill/follow-up schedule. Document only checks actually performed.

fields.label: Controlled medications and safety
fields.help: Prescribing and PMP documentation should follow Astra policy and all relevant law/clinical judgment. Never prepopulate PMP as completed without actual review.

fields.label: Billing workflow

globalRules.when: IF patient age is 18+ AND requester is anyone other than patient
globalRules.detail: Adult patient must personally submit request. No parent, partner or proxy scheduling request through this workflow.

globalRules.when: IF patient age is <13 OR requested telehealth location outside NY/CT/DE
globalRules.detail: Do not automatically book; notify patient of review/limits.

globalRules.when: IF prescreen positive/unsure on LAI, OUD treatment, schizophrenia spectrum, recent higher care, or possible acute risk
globalRules.detail: Clinician/staff judgment; no automatic diagnosis or denial.

globalRules.when: IF request status is APPROVED (not merely submitted)
globalRules.detail: Send age, modality and payer-appropriate intake; track completion and preserve collected demographics.

globalRules.when: IF selected family history matrix cell
globalRules.detail: Offer optional note for EXACT relative × condition; retain granular entries.

globalRules.when: IF a selected outside clinician is approved for communication
globalRules.detail: Create separate prefilled recipient-specific ROI subject to state/minor/Part 2 requirements.

globalRules.when: IF previous intake/history data exists
globalRules.detail: Persisted chart histories appear to provider, but not unconditionally pasted into current signed note.

globalRules.when: IF clinical data is explicitly checked for inclusion
globalRules.detail: Insert selected item with source and original date only.

globalRules.when: IF psychotherapy add-on CPT selected
globalRules.detail: Must pair with eligible E/M code and documented, distinct psychotherapy and payer rules.

globalRules.when: IF a field has executable show/hide rules or prefill mapping defined in the builder
globalRules.detail: The same structured rules power the interactive preview and the exported standalone developer file. Existing narrative-only IF→THEN rules are documentation, not executable checks.

globalRules.when: IF the patient submits appointment request
globalRules.detail: Gender for registration/payer marker is required; gender identity remains optional and stored separately. For an insured patient, gather payer, subscriber details, member ID, and secure front/back card images; validate mandatory fields before submission.

globalRules.when: IF patient selects Check my benefits AND insurance identifiers are complete
globalRules.detail: Connect to actual HIPAA-appropriate AdvancedMD/clearinghouse 270/271 eligibility lookup and present timestamped results only when available. Show provider network/behavioral-health benefits, copay, deductible, coinsurance, telehealth, prior authorization and limitations. Do not represent demo values as verified. Eligibility is not a guarantee of payment.

globalRules.when: IF approved patient is 18+
globalRules.detail: Collect adult patient photo ID securely in intake. For minors collect parent/guardian ID as appropriate and optional minor patient ID. Respect consent authority, minimum necessary access and retention.

globalRules.when: IF provider selects a condition family / code
globalRules.detail: Check active code status against FY2027 ICD-10-CM and appropriate CPT release, coding rules and payer requirements. Multiple primary E/M choices must not be blindly billed together; psychotherapy add-on requires eligible E/M and separate time/documentation.

globalRules.when: IF a patient checks any condition in the categorized medical checklist
globalRules.detail: Reveal an optional condition-specific detail box linked to its originating checklist, e.g., Arrhythmia → treatment/diagnosis details. It must follow the selected condition into provider-verifiable longitudinal history; do not require manually retyping condition names.

globalRules.when: IF the payer-demographic marker differs from gender identity
globalRules.detail: Capture required payer marker and optional gender identity as separate data items. Handle payer-specific fields through reconciliation; do not overwrite preferred name, gender identity or pronouns solely to satisfy electronic eligibility.

globalRules.when: IF in-person is requested AND patient cannot attend Bethany Beach, DE office
globalRules.detail: Offer telehealth or staff contact; do not show in-person availability in CT/NY.

globalRules.when: IF required contact/age/payer details are incomplete
globalRules.detail: Provide a field-level correction prompt before request can be submitted; suppress duplicate patient records by demographic matching.

globalRules.when: IF request mentions immediate danger or acute suicidality
globalRules.detail: Display emergency guidance immediately; no unattended web intake substitutes for crisis response or real-time triage.

globalRules.when: IF payer benefits are unavailable or inconclusive
globalRules.detail: Mark results pending, do not invent copays; permit staff to assist and resolve payer/registration gender marker discrepancies without overwriting identity fields.

globalRules.when: IF patient is a minor or representative requests portal access
globalRules.detail: Apply NY/CT/DE adolescent consent/confidentiality and custody rules to medical record, portal access, proxy messaging and ROI permissions; do not grant universal guardian access.

globalRules.when: IF intake information is carried into longitudinal chart histories
globalRules.detail: Retain patient-reported source, date and verification state; update persistent structured history without rewriting signed encounters or duplicating active medication records.

globalRules.when: IF identity and insurance images are uploaded
globalRules.detail: Collect via secured patient portal with appropriate permissions and retention; do not embed real ID or card images in exported mockups or narrative notes.

globalRules.when: IF self-pay patient is approved
globalRules.detail: Present applicable Good Faith Estimate, rates, financial policy and secure PCI-tokenized card-on-file authorization; avoid direct card/CVV collection in ordinary forms.

globalRules.when: IF intake is incomplete approaching appointment
globalRules.detail: Track per-document and screeners completion, send appropriate reminders, and provide staff exception workflow before visit.

globalRules.when: IF clinician finalizes encounter
globalRules.detail: Require current-visit MSE confirmation, appropriate risk assessment, correct active diagnoses, reviewed medications, service/time support, audit trail and immutable signed note.

globalRules.when: IF AdvancedMD cannot store patient intake in discrete editable chart fields
globalRules.detail: Escalate before go-live. A PDF attachment alone does not meet Astra’s proposed longitudinal history requirement.
